items.text: San Francisco FINAL: OUT - WR Mike Evans (Achilles), WR Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring), WR Christian Kirk (knee). RB Christian McCaffrey and DE Nick Bosa have no designation and will play. Questionable - WR Demarcus Robinson (ankle, likely active), CB Upton Stout, DB Nate Hobbs, DB Siran Neal. Brock Purdy starts.
Las Vegas FINAL: DT Thomas Booker (ankle) OUT; CB Darien Porter (groin) questionable. Kirk Cousins starts.
